# Messaging

## Core message

Tidewater is the dispatch board for regional moving crews.

## Proof points

Customers get a text with their arrival window, so the office stops fielding calls about where the truck is.

## Objections and answers

"We already have a whiteboard." A whiteboard cannot text the customer when the crew is running late.

## Words we use and avoid

We say dispatch board, never moving CRM.

## What the material does not show

Nothing in the material covers this.
